ocr.quote_zh: 使生如夏花之绚烂，死如秋叶之静美。——泰戈尔

words.example_en: The approaching examination created a tense atmosphere on the campus.
words.example_zh: 即将到来的考试在校园里制造了一种紧张气氛。
words.collocations: [搭] atmosphere pressure 大气压；working atmosphere 工作环境，工作氛围
words.word_formation: atmo（水汽）+ sphere（球体，球形）→ 大气圈。

words.example_en: All the water of the earth's surface is included in the hydrosphere.
words.example_zh: 地球表面的水都属于水圈的范畴。
words.word_formation: hydro（水）+ sphere（球体，球形）→ 水圈。

words.example_en: The hydrosphere and the lithosphere together form the earth's surface.
words.example_zh: 水圈与岩石圈一起形成地球的表面。
words.word_formation: litho（石头）+ sphere（球体，球形）→ 岩石圈。

words.example_en: Hydrogen and oxygen are gases.
words.example_zh: 氢气和氧气是气体。

words.example_en: Oxide is a part of our daily life.
words.example_zh: 氧化物是我们日常生活的一部分。

words.example_en: Soft drinks usually contain carbon dioxide.
words.example_zh: 软饮料中通常含有二氧化碳。

words.example_en: Two parts hydrogen, one part oxygen, you'll get water every time.
words.example_zh: 两份氢加一份氧，你就会得到水。
words.word_formation: hydro（水）+ gen（生成）→ 因氢气（与氧气混合燃烧后）会产生水而得名。

words.example_en: He is the core of the working group.
words.example_zh: 他是这个工作小组的核心。

words.example_en: The crust on the snow was thick enough for us to walk on it.
words.example_zh: 雪上冻结的那层冰很厚，足以让我们在上面行走。

words.example_en: Parents often use mantles for their babies to keep warm.
words.example_zh: 父母经常用披风给婴儿御寒。
words.notes: 中文词语“衣钵相传”原为佛家用语。英文相应表达为 take up/on the mantle（拿起/接受披风），语出《圣经》。先知以利亚曾用自己的披风分开约旦河水。后来他被接引上天后留下了这件披风，他的继承者拾起披风，借此同样分开了约旦河水。所以 mantle 在西方文化中被视为法力或权力传承的媒介。西方魔术师的标准行头里就少不了一件 mantle。

words.example_en: The captain determines the latitude and longitude of his ship.
words.example_zh: 船长查明船的经纬度。
words.collocations: [搭] a line of longitude 经线

words.example_en: Our position is 40 degrees north latitude.
words.example_zh: 我们的位置是北纬 40 度。
words.collocations: [搭] high latitudes 高纬度地区

words.example_en: I could see a ship on the horizon.
words.example_zh: 我看见地平线上有一艘轮船。
words.collocations: [搭] broaden sb.'s horizons 开阔眼界
words.notes: [记] horizontal adj. 水平的

words.example_en: We are currently flying at an altitude of 8,000 metres.
words.example_zh: 我们目前正在海拔 8000 米的高空飞行。
words.word_formation: alt（高）+ itude（表示性质、状态等）→ 高度。

words.example_en: There was a great flood disaster in East China.
words.example_zh: 华东发生了严重的水灾。
words.collocations: [搭] a disaster film/movie 灾难片
words.notes: [记] disastrous adj. 灾难性的。跨页续文：古人爱夜观星相。某一天晚上，人们突然发现：咦，有……

words.example_en: A mishap prevented him from attending the routine company meeting.
words.example_zh: 他遇到点儿麻烦，没能来参加公司的例会。
words.word_formation: mis（坏的，错的，不好的）+ hap（运气）→ 不幸。

words.example_en: If the forecast had been wrong, the consequences could have been catastrophic.
words.example_zh: 如果这个预报是错误的，那么结果本可能会是灾难性的。

words.example_en: A hurricane would be a calamity for this low-lying coastal region.
words.example_zh: 对于这片地势低洼的沿海地区，飓风会带来灾难。
words.collocations: [搭] cause a calamity 酿成灾祸

words.example_en: If you work hard without rest, you will endanger your health.
words.example_zh: 你若辛勤工作而不休息，会把身体弄坏的。
words.word_formation: en（使）+ danger（危险）→ 使遭受危险。
words.notes: [记] endangered adj. 濒临灭绝的

words.example_en: If you are rude to the boss, your chances of success may be jeopardised.
words.example_zh: 如果你对老板没有礼貌，就有可能危害到你成功的机会。
words.collocations: [搭] jeopardise sb.'s life 危及某人的生命

words.example_en: Jealousy is an extremely destructive emotion.
words.example_zh: 嫉妒是一种极具破坏性的情绪。
words.word_formation: de（除去）+ struct（建造）+ ive（形容词后缀）→ 毁坏建筑 → 破坏性的。
words.notes: [记] destroy v. 摧毁

words.meaning_zh: 厄尔尼诺现象（赤道附近东太平洋水域大范围海水反常增温、鱼群大量死亡的现象）
words.example_en: What changed the equation that year was El Niño.
words.example_zh: 那年是厄尔尼诺现象打破了这种平衡。
words.notes: 例句在右栏顶部续排。

words.example_en: The flowers are grown in the greenhouse.
words.example_zh: 这些花是在温室里栽培的。
words.collocations: [搭] the greenhouse effect 温室效应；a greenhouse gas 温室气体

words.example_en: Snow is an almost unknown phenomenon in Egypt.
words.example_zh: 在埃及，雪几乎是种不为人知的现象。
words.collocations: [搭] a natural phenomenon 自然现象；a social phenomenon 社会现象
words.word_formation: pheno（显示，出现）+ menon（名词后缀）→ 现象。
words.notes: [记] 复数形式：phenomena

words.example_en: The boy put his hand into the money bag and drew out a pebble.
words.example_zh: 男孩把手伸进钱袋中，拿出了一粒鹅卵石。

words.example_en: He picked all the pins up with a magnet.
words.example_zh: 他用磁铁捡起了所有的大头针。
words.notes: [记] magnetic adj. 磁的，有磁性的；有吸引力的。希腊人在马格内西亚（Magnesia）地区发现了一种神奇的矿石，这种矿石可以吸引金属。希腊人将这种矿石称为“马格内西亚的石头”。

words.example_en: This mountain area is rich in iron ore.
words.example_zh: 这片山区富含铁矿。
review_reasons: typhoon_note_contains_a_low_confidence_cultural_etymology_phrase

words.example_en: China is rich in mineral resources.
words.example_zh: 中国的矿产资源丰富。
words.word_formation: 来自 mine（矿山）的东西 → 矿物。
review_reasons: typhoon_note_contains_a_low_confidence_cultural_etymology_phrase

words.example_en: They used marble to build the steps.
words.example_zh: 他们用大理石修建台阶。
review_reasons: typhoon_note_contains_a_low_confidence_cultural_etymology_phrase

words.example_en: Have you bought the quartz clock?
words.example_zh: 你买那座石英钟了吗？
review_reasons: typhoon_note_contains_a_low_confidence_cultural_etymology_phrase

words.example_en: His grave is made of granite.
words.example_zh: 他的墓是用花岗石造成的。
words.collocations: [搭] bite on granite 白费力气，徒劳无功
words.word_formation: gran（颗粒）+ ite（名词后缀）→ 有颗粒的石头 → 花岗岩。
review_reasons: typhoon_note_contains_a_low_confidence_cultural_etymology_phrase

words.example_en: A gust of wind blew the leaves off the trees.
words.example_zh: 一阵狂风把树叶从树上吹落。
review_reasons: typhoon_note_contains_a_low_confidence_cultural_etymology_phrase

words.example_en: We are enjoying the cool breeze that comes from the lake.
words.example_zh: 我们享受着湖面上吹来的凉爽微风。
review_reasons: typhoon_note_contains_a_low_confidence_cultural_etymology_phrase

words.example_en: The monsoon brings rain to us.
words.example_zh: 季风给我们带来了降雨。
words.collocations: [搭] monsoon season 雨季
review_reasons: typhoon_note_contains_a_low_confidence_cultural_etymology_phrase

words.example_en: We got our roof blown off in a gale last night.
words.example_zh: 昨夜的大风把我们的房顶给掀掉了。
words.collocations: [搭] a severe gale 一阵大风
review_reasons: typhoon_note_contains_a_low_confidence_cultural_etymology_phrase

words.example_en: The hurricane flung their motorboat upon the rocks.
words.example_zh: 飓风把他们的摩托艇抛到了岩石上。
review_reasons: typhoon_note_contains_a_low_confidence_cultural_etymology_phrase

words.example_en: When a tornado touches the ground, it does a lot of damage.
words.example_zh: 当龙卷风到达地面时，会造成很大破坏。
review_reasons: typhoon_note_contains_a_low_confidence_cultural_etymology_phrase

words.example_en: The typhoon is gathering strength.
words.example_zh: 台风的风力正逐渐增强。
words.notes: typhoon 通常指发生在太平洋西部海洋和南海海域的热带气旋。该词的形成与汉语“[unclear]”的发音有关。
review_reasons: typhoon_note_contains_a_low_confidence_cultural_etymology_phrase

words.example_en: The volcano erupted and two small towns were buried under metres of hot ash, mud and bits of molten rock.
words.example_zh: 这次火山爆发将两座小镇掩埋于数米厚炽热的火山灰、泥浆和熔岩碎块之下。
words.collocations: [搭] an active/dormant/extinct volcano 活/休眠/死火山；sit on a volcano 处境危险
words.notes: 该词来自罗马神话中的火神伏尔坎（Vulcan）。他的妻子是鼎鼎大名的爱与美的女神维纳斯（Venus），后来维纳斯爱上了战神帅哥，红杏出墙，还生下了私生子丘比特（Cupid）！武尔坎招惹不起强大的情敌，只好躲在地底下打铁，胸中的怒火、炉火和火炉同时喷发，于是火星和浓烟从山顶喷出，形成火山（volcano）爆发。
review_reasons: typhoon_note_contains_a_low_confidence_cultural_etymology_phrase

words.meaning_zh: 爆发，喷发；（斑疹等）突然出现
words.example_en: Hot lava erupted from the crust.
words.example_zh: 从地壳中喷发出了滚烫的熔岩。
words.notes: [记] eruption n. 喷发，爆发
review_reasons: typhoon_note_contains_a_low_confidence_cultural_etymology_phrase

words.example_en: Some types of minerals are made when magma cools and solidifies.
words.example_zh: 有些类型的矿物是在岩浆冷却凝固的过程中形成的。
words.notes: 字根 magma 意为“揉、捏”，另外在希腊语中 magma 意为“浓厚的软膏”，后引申为岩浆，因其流动起来柔软如膏。

words.example_en: His theory violates current thermodynamic laws.
words.example_zh: 他的理论违反了当前的热力学定律。
words.word_formation: thermo（热）+ dynamic（力的；力学）→ 热力的；热力学的。
words.notes: [记] thermodynamics n. 热力学

words.example_en: The smog was so bad that schoolchildren were advised to stay indoors.
words.example_zh: 雾霾太严重，建议小学生们留在室内。
words.word_formation: 英文中的混合构词法：smoke + fog → smog（烟雾）；motel = motor + hotel（汽车旅馆）；heliport = helicopter + airport（直升机场）；brunch = breakfast + lunch（早午餐）。
words.notes: [记] smoggy adj. 烟雾弥漫的

words.meaning_zh: [~s]（难闻且常为有害的）烟，气体；冒烟；发怒
words.example_en: Petrol fumes from cars are poisoning the atmosphere.
words.example_zh: 汽车排放的汽油烟气正在污染大气。

words.meaning_zh: 薄雾；水汽；使视线模糊的东西
words.example_en: She could hardly recognise her son through a mist of tears.
words.example_zh: 她泪眼模糊，几乎不能认出自己的儿子。
words.collocations: [搭] lost in the mists of time 淹没在时间的迷雾中
words.notes: [记] misty adj. 有雾的；模糊的

words.example_en: A terrible tsunami followed the earthquake.
words.example_zh: 一场骇人的海啸跟随地震而来。

words.example_en: Many areas in Africa have suffered severe drought this year.
words.example_zh: 今年，非洲的很多地区遭受了严重的干旱。
words.notes: 词源同 dry（adj. 干的，干燥的）。

words.example_en: Since the flooding began last month, 16 people have died statewide.
words.example_zh: 自上个月洪水暴发以来，全州已有 16 人死亡。
words.notes: [记] flood v. 淹没；充满 n. 洪水

words.example_en: A torrent of water poured down the mountain.
words.example_zh: 激流从山上奔流而下。

words.example_en: Several countries in eastern Europe are counting the losses caused by yesterday's earthquake.
words.example_zh: 东欧的几个国家正在统计昨天地震造成的人员伤亡。
words.word_formation: earth（地球）+ quake（震动）→ 地震。
words.notes: [记] quake v. 震动，颤动

words.example_en: The discovery of seismic activity suggests geological activity could provide large amounts of heat and minerals.
words.example_zh: 地震活动的发现表明地质运动可以提供大量的热量和矿物质。
words.collocations: [搭] a seismic wave 地震波

words.example_en: Yesterday's avalanche destroyed several trees.
words.example_zh: 昨天的雪崩毁坏了一些树木。

words.example_en: He climbed a tree to view the surrounding terrain.
words.example_zh: 他爬上一棵树去查看周围的地形。
words.collocations: [搭] a terrain feature 地形特征

words.meaning_zh: 风景，地貌；对……进行景观美化
words.example_en: The trees and the mountains made the landscape very beautiful.
words.example_zh: 树木和山脉使风景变得很美。
words.word_formation: land（陆地）+ scape（表示性质、状况等）→ 地貌。

words.example_en: It is generally thought that Columbus discovered the American continents.
words.example_zh: 人们通常认为是哥伦布发现了美洲大陆。
words.notes: [记] continental adj. 大陆的，大陆性的

words.example_en: This cave was used by smugglers in the eighteenth century.
words.example_zh: 这洞穴曾在 18 世纪被走私者使用。
words.collocations: [搭] explore a cave 勘探山洞

words.example_en: The narrow path leads to a wooden hut on the cliff.
words.example_zh: 这条狭窄的小径通向悬崖上的一个小木屋。

words.example_en: The glacier dislocated the great stones.
words.example_zh: 冰川使巨石脱离原位。

words.example_en: In the swamp, we were beset by mosquitoes.
words.example_zh: 在沼泽地里，我们受到蚊子围攻。

words.example_en: The Nile Delta used to be a fertile land.
words.example_zh: 尼罗河三角洲曾是一片肥沃的土地。
words.notes: 源于希腊字母表的第四个字母 Δ，因为状似三角，被用来表示“三角洲”。

words.example_en: Once there were 70 million buffalo roaming the Great Plains.
words.example_zh: 曾经有 7000 万头野牛在北美洲大平原上漫步。

words.example_en: The atmosphere is thin on the plateau.
words.example_zh: 高原的空气稀薄。
words.collocations: [搭] plateau climate 高原气候
words.notes: 某些法语词在被借入英语中时仍然保留了其拼写习惯，如法语字母组合 eau：plateau（高原），bureau（[政府机构的]局），tableau（静态画面），beau（情郎，男友），nouveau riche（暴发户），等等。

words.example_en: Oasis symbolises a hope in desert areas.
words.example_zh: 绿洲在沙漠地区象征着一种希望。

words.example_en: There are people in almost every habitable part of this globe.
words.example_zh: 地球上几乎每一处适于居住的地方都有人在。
words.collocations: [搭] travel around the globe 环游世界
words.notes: [记] global adj. 全球的；总体的

words.example_en: In the northern hemisphere, you can hardly see the Magellanic Clouds.
words.example_zh: 在北半球，你几乎看不到麦哲伦云。
words.collocations: [搭] the northern hemisphere 北半球
words.word_formation: hemi（半）+ sphere（球）→ 半球。
words.notes: [记] hemispheric adj. 半球形状的；半球的

words.example_en: The equator is an imaginary line around the middle of the earth.
words.example_zh: 赤道是一条假想的环绕地球中部的线。
words.notes: [记] equal adj. 平等的

words.meaning_zh: 极冷的；[A~] 北极的；[the A~] 北极地区，北极
words.example_en: The polar bear's habitat is the icy waters of the Arctic.
words.example_zh: 北极熊的栖息地是冰冷的北极海域。
words.collocations: [搭] the Arctic Ocean 北冰洋

words.meaning_zh: 南极的；[the ~] 南极地区，南极洲
words.example_en: Because of the extreme cold, the environment in the Antarctic is uniquely fragile.
words.example_zh: 极度严寒造成了南极地区绝无仅有的脆弱环境。
words.word_formation: ant（对面的）+ arctic（北极）→ 北极的对面 → 南极。

words.example_en: English is spoken from pole to pole.
words.example_zh: 英语在世界各地都通用。
words.collocations: [搭] the South Pole 南极

words.meaning_zh: 极地的，近极地的；对立的
words.example_en: In these polar regions, the balance of nature has already been disrupted.
words.example_zh: 在南极地区和北极地区，大自然的平衡已被破坏。
words.collocations: [搭] a polar bear 北极熊

words.example_en: The earth's axis is the line between the North and South Poles.
words.example_zh: 地轴是南北极之间的线。

words.example_en: Relations between the two countries have deteriorated sharply in recent weeks.
words.example_zh: 最近几周，那两个国家间的关系严重恶化了。
words.notes: [记] deterioration n. 恶化，变坏

words.example_en: Grief aggravated her illness.
words.example_zh: 痛苦加重了她的病。
words.collocations: [搭] aggravate the differences 加深分歧
words.word_formation: ag（加强意义）+ grav（重的）+ ate（使）→ 使变重，加重。
words.notes: [记] gravity n. 重力；aggregate v./n. 合计，总计

words.meaning_zh: 降解；降低……的身份；使恶化，使退化
words.example_en: A dishonest action like that will degrade you.
words.example_zh: 这样不诚实的行为有辱你的身份。
words.word_formation: de（向下）+ grade（层级）→ 降级。
words.notes: [记] degradation n. 恶化

words.example_en: The antivirus software should often be upgraded.
words.example_zh: 杀毒软件应当经常升级。
words.collocations: [搭] upgrade (sth.) to sth.（把某物）升级为某物
words.word_formation: up（向上）+ grade（层级）→ 升级。

words.example_en: The waves erode the rocks on the shore.
words.example_zh: 海浪侵蚀着岸边的岩石。
words.notes: [记] erosion n. 侵蚀，腐蚀

words.meaning_zh: adj. 地中海的；地中海地区的；n. 地中海；地中海地区
words.example_en: This dish is a cross between Asian and Mediterranean food.
words.example_zh: 这道菜融合了亚洲和地中海的风味。

words.meaning_zh: adj. 大西洋的；n. [the ~] 大西洋
words.example_en: The Atlantic coast is within sight of the hotel.
words.example_zh: 从宾馆可以看见大西洋海岸。

words.meaning_zh: adj. 平静的，和平的；[P~] 太平洋的；n. [the P~] 太平洋
words.example_en: What a beautiful and pacific place this is!
words.example_zh: 这是一个多么美丽而平静的地方啊！
words.collocations: Asian-Pacific region 亚太地区；Asian-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) 亚太经合组织；Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) 石油输出国组织
words.notes: 来自 pacify（v. 平息，安抚，使平静）。

words.example_en: These creatures live in the depth of the Pacific Ocean.
words.example_zh: 这些生物生活在太平洋的深处。
words.collocations: [搭] an ocean of / oceans of 大量

words.meaning_zh: adj. 海生的，海洋的；海事的；n. 水兵
words.example_en: It is true that a lot of people like marine plants as their food.
words.example_zh: 确实有很多人喜欢食用海洋植物。
words.collocations: a marine product 海产品；船用产品
words.notes: 字根 mar 表示“海（sea）”，又如：mariner（水手，海员），submarine（海底的；潜艇）。

words.example_en: Navigation is a game for brave people.
words.example_zh: 航海是勇敢者的游戏。
words.notes: [记] navigator n. 航海家；导航员，领航员

words.example_en: The gulf extends northward.
words.example_zh: 海湾向北方延伸。

words.example_en: They walked along the beach, talking and laughing.
words.example_zh: 他们说说笑笑，沿着海滩散步。

words.example_en: He is going to live by the coast for the sake of his health.
words.example_zh: 他为了自己的健康，打算到海滨地区居住。

words.example_en: His ship pulled in to the shore at midnight.
words.example_zh: 他的船半夜时靠岸。

words.example_en: The gravitational attraction between the moon and the earth causes tides.
words.example_zh: 月亮与地球间的引力引起潮汐。
words.collocations: [搭] at low tide 退潮时，低潮时；Time and tide wait for no man. 岁月不等人。
words.notes: [记] tidal adj. 潮汐的

words.example_en: He was swept away by the current.
words.example_zh: 他被激流卷走了。

words.example_en: Before we drink at a brook, it is good to know its source.
words.example_zh: 溪畔畅饮前，最好知其源。

words.meaning_zh: n. 小河，溪；流；v. 流动，流出
words.example_en: On either bank of the stream stand rows of willow trees.
words.example_zh: 小河两岸柳树成行。

words.example_en: I've heard from reliable sources that the company is in trouble.
words.example_zh: 我听到来源可靠的消息称，公司遇到了麻烦。
words.notes: [记] resource n. 资源；例句续排至下一页。

words.example_en: The sea is shallow here.
words.example_zh: 这儿的海水很浅。
words.notes: [记] shallow-hearted adj. 薄情的

words.example_en: Superficial scratches can be easily removed.
words.example_zh: 表层的划痕是很容易去掉的。
words.collocations: a superficial injury 皮外伤

words.example_en: In flat open country, there is plenty of grass for the cattle to feed on.
words.example_zh: 在开阔平坦的地区，有大量的青草供牛群食用。

words.example_en: The process of negotiation was not entirely smooth.
words.example_zh: 谈判的过程并不十分顺畅。
words.notes: [记] smoothly adv. 光滑地；平稳地；流畅地

words.example_en: You'd better give us a rough idea of your price.
words.example_zh: 你最好给我们一个粗略的价格。
words.notes: [记] roughly adv. 粗糙地；粗略地

words.example_en: We walked across the fields on the sandy path.
words.example_zh: 我们踩着这条沙路穿过田野。
words.word_formation: sand（沙）+ y（形容词后缀）→ 含沙的。

words.example_en: The ground in this part of the country is poor and stony.
words.example_zh: 该国这个地区的土地贫瘠多石。

words.example_en: In some places the cliff was almost vertical, and too dangerous to climb.
words.example_zh: 在一些地方，悬崖几乎是垂直的，非常危险，不能攀登。
words.notes: [记] horizontal adj. 水平的

words.example_en: A long steep path leads to a teahouse with a grand view of the sea.
words.example_zh: 一条长而陡的小径通向一家能看见海景的茶室。

words.meaning_zh: n. 平行线；相似之物；相似之处；adj. 平行的；v. 与……相似；比得上
words.example_en: There are few parallels between American football and European football.
words.example_zh: 美式足球（橄榄球）和欧洲足球之间几乎没有什么相似之处。
words.notes: [记] unparalleled adj. 无比的，无双的

words.meaning_zh: adj. 狭窄的；有局限的；n. [~s] 海峡；v. 变窄
words.example_en: The only access to the garden is by a narrow path at the side of the house.
words.example_zh: 到花园去的唯一途径是走房屋侧面的一条窄窄的小路。
words.collocations: [搭] narrow down 减少；限制

words.example_en: Oceania is a separate landmass, but it is separated from Asia by very shallow water.
words.example_zh: 大洋洲是一块单独的陆地，但它与亚洲之间只隔着很浅的水域。

words.example_en: Hawaii and Alaska are not on the mainland of the United States.
words.example_zh: 夏威夷和阿拉斯加不在美国本土上。

words.example_en: His house is located on the tip of the peninsula.
words.example_zh: 他的房子位于半岛的顶端。

words.example_en: The current political climate in that country is favourable for foreign investment.
words.example_zh: 该国目前的政治环境有利于外国投资。
words.collocations: [搭] in the present economic climate 在当前的经济形势下

words.example_en: In warm weather, you should wear clothing that is cool and comfortable.
words.example_zh: 天气温暖时，你应该穿凉快而舒适的衣服。

words.example_en: Nowadays, few people like to study meteorology.
words.example_zh: 现在，很少有人愿意学气象学。
words.word_formation: meteor（高处的事物）+ logy（学说）→ 气象学。
words.notes: [记] meteorological adj. 气象的

words.example_en: The weather is mild today; it is neither hot nor cold.
words.example_zh: 今天的天气温暖舒适，不热也不冷。
words.collocations: a mild climate 温和的气候

words.example_en: The workers are installing a heating system.
words.example_zh: 工人们正在安装供暖系统。
words.collocations: [搭] central heating 中央暖气系统
words.notes: [记] heat n. 热；强烈感情；v.（使）变热

words.meaning_zh: adj. 适度的；温和的；中等的；v.（使）缓和
words.example_en: The wind was strong all day, but it moderated in the evening.
words.example_zh: 一整天，风都刮得很厉害，但到傍晚时有所减弱了。
words.collocations: a moderate climate 温和的气候

words.example_en: The blood of a warm-blooded animal remains around the same temperature both on warm and cold days.
words.example_zh: 不论天气温暖还是寒冷，恒温动物的血都会保持基本不变的温度。
words.notes: [记] warmth n. 温暖；热情

words.example_en: The thermal energy has become more and more important.
words.example_zh: 热能变得越来越重要了。

words.example_en: He lives in the tropics.
words.example_zh: 他住在热带地区。
words.collocations: [搭] in the tropics 在热带地区
words.notes: [记] tropical adj. 热带的

words.example_en: It is difficult to grow fruit in arid desert areas.
words.example_zh: 在干燥的沙漠地带栽培水果很困难。
words.collocations: [搭] an arid desert 干旱的荒漠

words.example_en: His eyes were moist with tears.
words.example_zh: 泪水润湿了他的眼睛。
words.notes: [记] moisture n. 潮气，湿气；水分

words.example_en: The damp match won't strike.
words.example_zh: 这潮湿的火柴划不着。
words.collocations: [搭] a damp climate 潮湿的气候
words.notes: [记] dampness n. 潮湿

words.example_en: The milk powder has lumped together because my home is so humid.
words.example_zh: 我家太潮湿了，所以奶粉结块了。
words.collocations: [搭] humid conditions 湿热的天气状况
words.notes: [记] humidity n. 高温潮湿；湿度

words.example_en: The snowy weather lasted the whole time we were there.
words.example_zh: 我们在那儿的整段时间都是下雪的天气。
words.notes: [记] snow n. 雪

words.example_en: Sweet potatoes decayed after the frost.
words.example_zh: 发生霜冻之后，甘薯烂掉了。
words.notes: [记] frosty adj. 结霜的；严寒的；例句续排至下一页。

words.meaning_zh: n. 雹，冰雹；v. 赞扬；招呼；下雹
words.example_en: It hailed during the night.
words.example_zh: 夜间下了冰雹。

words.meaning_zh: v. 解冻，融解，融化；n. 解冻时期
words.example_en: The sun thawed the ice and melted the snow.
words.example_zh: 阳光之下，冰消雪融。
words.collocations: [搭] thaw (sth.) out （使冷冻食品）解冻；（使某物）变暖

words.meaning_zh: v.（使）变冷；使恐惧；n. 寒冷；害怕
words.example_en: The bad news cast a chill over the whole family.
words.example_zh: 这坏消息使全家人感到不寒而栗。
words.collocations: [搭] chill enthusiasm 使热情冷却
words.notes: [记] chilly adj. 寒冷的

words.meaning_zh: v. 结冰；n. 霜冻；严寒期
words.example_en: The weatherman predicted a freeze for tonight.
words.example_zh: 天气预报员预报今晚有霜冻。
words.notes: [记] freezer n. 冰柜；freezing adj. 极冷的

words.example_en: Hohhot is a frigid city in winter.
words.example_zh: 冬天的呼和浩特十分寒冷。
words.collocations: [搭] the frigid zones 寒带；a frigid climate 极冷的气候

words.example_en: There was a tremble in her voice.
words.example_zh: 她的声音颤抖着。
words.collocations: [搭] tremble all over 浑身颤抖

words.example_en: She shivered because she was worried and afraid.
words.example_zh: 她因担忧和害怕而发抖。
words.collocations: [搭] shiver with cold 冷得发抖
words.notes: 以 er 结尾的词，常常表示一种反复状态，如：batter（连续用 bat [球棒] 击打 → 连续猛击），chatter（反复 chat [聊天] → 喋喋不休），flicker（摇曳，闪烁不定），teeter（蹒跚行走；摇摇欲坠），teeter-totter（反复出现摇摇欲坠的状态 → 跷跷板）。

words.meaning_zh: n. 雷；雷声；v. 打雷；轰隆隆地快速移动
words.example_en: An express train thundered through the station.
words.example_zh: 一辆快车轰隆隆地驶过车站。
words.notes: [记] thunderstorm n. 雷雨

words.meaning_zh: n. 闪电；adj. 闪电般的，极快的
words.example_en: During the storm, flashes of lightning appeared in the sky.
words.example_zh: 暴风雨中，道道闪电划过天空。
words.notes: [记] lighten v. 使变轻；（使）发亮；lighter n. 打火机；lightly adv. 轻轻地；轻松地

words.meaning_zh: 有暴风雨的；争吵激烈的；（大海）波涛汹涌的
words.example_en: Our ship was tossed about on the stormy sea.
words.example_zh: 我们的船在波涛汹涌的海面上颠簸。
words.notes: [记] storm n. 暴风雨

words.example_en: For the past six hours, the downpour had been continuous.
words.example_zh: 过去的六个小时里，倾盆大雨持续不断。
words.word_formation: down（向下）+ pour（倾倒）→ 倾盆大雨。

words.example_en: There have been four years of below-average rainfall.
words.example_zh: 已经有四年降雨量低于平均值了。
words.word_formation: rain（雨）+ fall（降落）→ 降雨量。

words.meaning_zh: v. 撒，洒；下小雨；n. 少量；小雨
words.example_en: We've only had a few sprinkles of rain recently.
words.example_zh: 近来，我们这里只下过几场小雨。
words.collocations: [搭] sprinkle sth. on sth. 把某物洒/撒到某物上
words.notes: 搭配在下一页顶部续排。

words.example_en: A rainbow is usually seen after a heavy rain.
words.example_zh: 彩虹通常在大雨之后出现。

words.example_en: The weatherman predicts showers this afternoon.
words.example_zh: 气象预报员预报今天下午有阵雨。

words.meaning_zh: adj. 摄氏的；n. 摄氏温度
words.example_en: The maximum temperature in July may be 36 degrees Celsius.
words.example_zh: 7月的最高温度可能达到36摄氏度。
words.notes: [记] Fahrenheit adj. 华氏的；n. 华氏温度。以摄氏温标最初的提出者，即18世纪的瑞典科学家 Anders Celsius 的名字命名。

words.example_en: After the storm, there will be a sharp drop in temperature.
words.example_zh: 暴风雨过后，气温将骤降。
words.collocations: [搭] take the temperature 量温度

words.meaning_zh: n. 预测，预报；v. 预测，预言
words.example_en: The recent statement of the president forecasts a change in the situation.
words.example_zh: 总统最近的一次讲话预示着形势将有所变化。
words.word_formation: fore（前，先）+ cast（扔）→ 预先扔下 → 预报。

words.meaning_zh: n. 山峰；顶点；v. 达到最大值
words.example_en: The mountain peaks are covered with snow all year round.
words.example_zh: 山峰上终年覆盖着雪。
words.collocations: [搭] a mountain peak 山峰

words.meaning_zh: v. 渐渐增加；爬上，登上；n. [M~] 山
words.example_en: The old lady can only mount the stairs with difficulty.
words.example_zh: 这位老妇人上楼梯十分艰难。

words.example_en: The northern side of the mountain is almost vertical.
words.example_zh: 这座山的北坡几乎是垂直的。
words.notes: [记] mountainous adj. 多山的

words.example_en: A range of hills rose on our left.
words.example_zh: 山脉在我们左方出现。
words.collocations: [搭] in the range of 在……范围内；在……射程内

words.meaning_zh: n. 山脊，山脉；v. 使隆起
words.example_en: The sky above the ridge of the mountains brightened.
words.example_zh: 山脊上方的天空变得明亮起来。

words.meaning_zh: v. 倾斜；有坡度；n. 山坡；斜坡
words.example_en: He ran up the slope to the top of the hill.
words.example_zh: 他跑上斜坡，来到山顶。

words.example_en: The valley was hidden from view in the mist.
words.example_zh: 溪谷隐没在雾霭之中，看不见了。
words.collocations: [搭] in a valley 在山谷里

words.example_en: The path steepened as they climbed the hillside.
words.example_zh: 他们顺着山坡往上爬，小径愈发陡峭。

words.example_en: The house on the hill overlooks the village.
words.example_zh: 从小山上的房子可以俯瞰村庄。
words.collocations: [搭] be easily overlooked 容易被忽略的
words.word_formation: over（在上）+ look（看）→ 在上面往下看 → 俯瞰。

words.example_en: Only in the southern part of Taiwan have I seen such scenery.
words.example_zh: 唯有在台湾南部我才见过这样的风景。
words.notes: 例句续排至下一页。

words.meaning_zh: n. 东南方；东南部；adj. 东南方的；东南部的
words.example_en: Austria lies to the southeast of Germany.
words.example_zh: 奥地利在德国的东南边。

words.meaning_zh: n. 西南方；西南部；adj. 西南方的；西南部的
words.example_en: Ireland is in the southwest of the British Isles.
words.example_zh: 爱尔兰在不列颠群岛的西南部。

words.meaning_zh: n. 东北方；东北部；adj. 东北方的；东北部的
words.example_en: Snow in October is nothing strange in northeast China.
words.example_zh: 在中国东北部，10月下雪不是什么奇怪的事。

words.meaning_zh: n. 西北方；西北部；adj. 西北方的；西北部的
words.example_en: There is a large hilly area in the northwest.
words.example_zh: 西北部有一大片丘陵地带。

words.example_en: The eastern situation is similarly intense.
words.example_zh: 东部的情况同样紧张。

words.meaning_zh: 东方的（尤指中国和日本的）
words.example_en: She has studied the cultures of oriental countries.
words.example_zh: 她研究过东方各国的文化。
words.word_formation: 字根 ori 意为“升起”→ 太阳升起的地方→东方的。同字根的又如：origin（太阳升起的地方 → 起源），originator（发起人），orient（太阳升起的地方 → 东方 → 向东 → 确定方向）。
words.notes: 在英美等地的一些大学，在新学年开始前后有一周叫 O-Week，即 Orientation Week，会给新生介绍大学的各种情况，让他们摸清方向，尽快适应。

words.example_en: Such a difficult operation may not succeed, but it's an inevitable gamble.
words.example_zh: 难度如此之大的手术可能会失败，但我们必须冒险一试。
words.word_formation: in（不）+ evitable（可避免的）→ 不可避免的。
words.notes: [记] evitable adj. 可避免的

words.meaning_zh: 不可逆转的；不可挽回的
words.example_en: He suffered irreversible brain damage from the incident.
words.example_zh: 他的大脑在事故中受伤，无法治愈。
words.word_formation: ir（不）+ re（回）+ vers（转）+ ible（可……的）→ 不可以转回来的 → 不可逆转的。

words.example_en: The patient is breathing irregularly.
words.example_zh: 病人的呼吸很不均匀。
words.notes: [记] regularly adv. 有规律地

words.example_en: Your bright red coat would be quite inappropriate for a funeral.
words.example_zh: 你鲜艳的红大衣很不适合葬礼。
words.notes: [记] appropriate adj. 恰当的，合适的

words.meaning_zh: 不正常的，反常的；变态的
words.example_en: El Niño will result in the abnormal weather.
words.example_zh: 厄尔尼诺现象将会导致异常的天气。
words.collocations: [搭] an abnormal climate 异常气候
words.word_formation: ab（不）+ normal（正常的）→ 不正常的。

words.example_en: The sediment of coffee will settle.
words.example_zh: 咖啡渣会沉淀下去。

words.example_en: River sediments gradually silted up the harbour.
words.example_zh: 河流的沉积物逐渐使港口淤塞。

words.example_en: We left the car and struck out along the muddy track.
words.example_zh: 我们下了车，开始沿着泥泞的小路前行。
words.notes: [记] mud n. 泥

words.example_en: Bricks and dishes are made from various kinds of clay.
words.example_zh: 砖和盘子由各种黏土制成。

words.meaning_zh: 污垢，灰尘；[尤美] 泥土
words.example_en: The children were outside, playing happily in the dirt.
words.example_zh: 孩子们正在外面的泥土地里开心地玩耍。
words.notes: [记] dirty adj. 脏的；下流的

words.example_en: The disease occurs most frequently in rural areas.
words.example_zh: 那种疾病多见于农村地区。
words.collocations: [搭] rural areas 农村地区

words.example_en: They proposed setting up a school in the suburbs.
words.example_zh: 他们建议在郊区成立一所学校。
words.word_formation: sub（接近）+ urb（城市）→ 城市附近。
words.notes: [记] suburban adj. 郊区的
review_reasons: The printed border example appears to use 'lead' rather than the expected past-tense 'led'; the visible wording is preserved for later review.

words.example_en: We live on the outskirts of the city.
words.example_zh: 我们住在这座城市的郊区。
review_reasons: The printed border example appears to use 'lead' rather than the expected past-tense 'led'; the visible wording is preserved for later review.

words.example_en: She came from a remote village.
words.example_zh: 她来自一个偏远的村子。
words.collocations: [搭] a remote control 遥控器
review_reasons: The printed border example appears to use 'lead' rather than the expected past-tense 'led'; the visible wording is preserved for later review.

words.example_en: So how should they escape from these desolate canyons?
words.example_zh: 那么他们要怎样逃出这些荒凉的峡谷呢？
review_reasons: The printed border example appears to use 'lead' rather than the expected past-tense 'led'; the visible wording is preserved for later review.

words.example_en: It snows all year round in that distant little village.
words.example_zh: 那个遥远的小村落整年下雪。
words.collocations: [搭] the distant past 遥远的过去
words.notes: [记] distance n. 距离，间距；远处
review_reasons: The printed border example appears to use 'lead' rather than the expected past-tense 'led'; the visible wording is preserved for later review.

words.example_en: We stayed in adjacent rooms.
words.example_zh: 我们待在相邻的房间。
words.collocations: [搭] adjacent to 与……毗连的
review_reasons: The printed border example appears to use 'lead' rather than the expected past-tense 'led'; the visible wording is preserved for later review.

words.example_en: All medicines are toxic.
words.example_zh: 所有药物都有毒性。
words.collocations: [搭] toxic waste 有毒废物；highly toxic 剧毒的
words.notes: [记] poisonous adj. 有毒的。来源于希腊语 toxon，意为“弓（bow）”，在荷马史诗《伊利亚特》中还能寻到其踪迹。后来在战争中，人们普遍在箭头上涂毒药，提高弓箭的杀伤力，字根 tox 就有了“毒”的含义。如：toxicant（毒物，毒药），detoxify（解毒），toxicologist（毒理学家），intoxicated（心里中毒的 → 陶醉的）。

words.example_zh: 他把一生奉献给了农业地质学的研究事业。
words.notes: [记] geological adj. 地质（学）的

words.example_en: The border incident lead to the war between the two countries.
words.example_zh: 这一边境事件导致了两国交战。
words.collocations: [搭] within the borders of 在……境内

words.example_en: There is no margin for error in our plan.
words.example_zh: 我们的计划不容有误。
words.collocations: [搭] allow a greater margin of 允许有更大的……余地

words.meaning_zh: n. 边缘；刘海儿；adj. 次要的；非主流的
words.example_en: We feel it's pretty good and we also offer some good fringe benefits.
words.example_zh: 我们觉得这很不错，而且我们还提供一些很好的附加福利。

words.example_en: It is generally accepted that earthquakes are caused by two tectonic plates bumping into each other.
words.example_zh: 人们普遍认为，地震是由两块构造板块互相碰撞造成的。

words.example_en: We are searching for his corpse among the debris after the explosion.
words.example_zh: 爆炸后，我在瓦砾堆中寻找着他的尸体。

words.meaning_zh: v. 破裂；发出爆裂声；n. 裂缝；缝隙
words.example_en: The door opened just a crack.
words.example_zh: 这扇门只打开一条缝。
words.collocations: [搭] cause a crack 弄出裂缝

words.example_en: There are wide gaps in my knowledge of history.
words.example_zh: 我的历史知识很贫乏。
words.collocations: [搭] the generation gap 代沟
words.notes: 例句跨栏排版。

words.example_en: You're all doing a splendid job; keep up the good work!
words.example_zh: 你们干得都很出色，要坚持下去！
words.collocations: [搭] a splendid chance 极好的机会

words.meaning_zh: 宏大的；豪华的，宏伟的；极好的
words.example_en: He was born in the purple and was brought up in the grand palace.
words.example_zh: 他出身于皇族，在宏伟的宫殿中长大。

words.meaning_zh: 壮丽的，宏伟的；令人印象深刻的
words.example_en: The king lived in this magnificent palace.
words.example_zh: 国王住在这座宏伟的宫殿里。
words.notes: [记] magnificence n. 宏伟，壮丽

words.example_en: I've discovered a super restaurant near here!
words.example_zh: 我在附近发现一家超级棒的餐馆！

words.example_en: There is an interesting programme on television tonight.
words.example_zh: 今天晚上有一档有趣的电视节目。
words.notes: [记] interested adj. 感兴趣的；有利害关系的

words.example_en: She made a dramatic speech at the meeting.
words.example_zh: 她在会上发表了激动人心的演说。
words.collocations: [搭] a dramatic event 令人印象深刻的事件
words.notes: [记] drama n. 戏剧

words.example_en: From his attic window, he looked out over a beautiful wilderness.
words.example_zh: 从阁楼的窗户望去，他看到一片美丽的荒野。
words.collocations: [搭] a wilderness area 保留自然环境面貌的地区
words.notes: [记] wild adj. 野生的；荒芜的

words.meaning_zh: n. 沙漠；v. 离弃，遗弃；擅离
words.example_en: The baby's mother deserted him soon after giving birth.
words.example_zh: 那个母亲生下他后不久就把他遗弃了。
words.collocations: [搭] a cultural desert 文化沙漠
words.notes: 注意与 dessert（n.［餐后］甜点，甜食）区分；例句与说明续排至下一页。

words.example_en: The land is severely eroded as a result of widespread deforesting and intensive farming.
words.example_zh: 土地因乱砍滥伐和密集耕种而受到严重侵蚀。
words.notes: [记] deforestation n. 毁林，滥伐森林

words.meaning_zh: 贫瘠的，荒芜的；不结果实的
words.example_en: That remote barren land has blossomed into rich granaries.
words.example_zh: 过去的穷乡僻壤变成了富饶的谷仓。
words.collocations: [搭] a barren desert 荒漠
words.notes: 知名组合“男孩地带”（Boyzone）有一首经典歌曲 No Matter What，其中一段歌词为 “No matter where it's barren, a dream is being born”，即“不论是什么荒芜的地方，都有梦在诞生”。

words.example_en: There's enough to transform barren coral atolls into fertile groves.
words.example_zh: 这足以将贫瘠的环礁变成富饶的丛林。

words.example_en: I fertilised the lawn and pulled out the weeds.
words.example_zh: 我为草坪施了肥又除了杂草。
words.notes: [记] fertiliser (= fertilizer) n. 肥料

words.example_en: This toy is operated by solar energy.
words.example_zh: 这个玩具是太阳能驱动的。
words.collocations: [搭] solar system 太阳系；solar energy 太阳能
words.notes: 来自拉丁语 sol，意为“太阳”。ar 是形容词后缀。

words.example_en: All traditional Chinese festivals are lunar calendar festivals.
words.example_zh: 中国传统节日的时间都是按照阴历定的。
words.collocations: [搭] a lunar eclipse 月食
words.notes: 来自拉丁语 luna，意为“月亮”。

words.example_en: The Islamic calendar has fewer days than the Gregorian calendar.
words.example_zh: 伊斯兰历比公历的天数少。
words.collocations: [搭] lunar calendar 阴历

words.example_en: The beauty of the sunrise is beyond description.
words.example_zh: 日出的美景难以描述。
words.collocations: [搭] at sunrise 日出时

words.example_en: By sunset we had covered thirty miles.
words.example_zh: 到日落的时候，我们已走了30英里。
words.collocations: [搭] at sunset 日落时；a sunset industry 夕阳产业（逐渐没落的产业）；sunset glow 晚霞

words.example_en: It will take about an hour to reach full eclipse stage.
words.example_zh: 要历时大约一个小时才能进入全食阶段。
words.collocations: [搭] a solar/lunar eclipse 日/月食

words.example_en: The street lights go on at dusk.
words.example_zh: 街灯在黄昏时亮起来。
words.collocations: [搭] by dusk 到黄昏时

words.meaning_zh: 天堂；极乐（之地）；[the ~s] 天空
words.example_en: Our week on the tropical island was heaven.
words.example_zh: 我们在那座热带小岛上待了一周，简直太开心了。

words.example_en: This club is a sportsman's paradise.
words.example_zh: 这个俱乐部是运动爱好者的乐园。
words.notes: 例句续排至下一页。

words.example_en: I was sitting in the garden, enjoying the sunshine.
words.example_zh: 我坐在庭院里，享受着阳光。
words.collocations: [搭] be bathed in sunshine 沐浴在阳光中

words.meaning_zh: n. 阴影部分；背阴处；v. 给……遮挡（光线）
words.example_en: He tried to shade his house with thick trees.
words.example_zh: 他试图用茂密的树木给房子遮阴。
words.collocations: [搭] provide shade 提供阴凉处
words.notes: [记] shady adj. 成荫的；阴凉的

words.example_en: The willow's shadow falls on the lake.
words.example_zh: 垂柳的影子投在湖面上。
words.collocations: [搭] cast a shadow 投下阴影

words.example_en: When water changes to water vapour, we say it evaporates.
words.example_zh: 当水变成水蒸气时，我们就称水蒸发了。

words.example_en: The pool of water on the playground evaporated in the sun.
words.example_zh: 操场上的那摊水在阳光下蒸发了。
words.notes: [记] evaporation n. 蒸发

words.example_en: Circulating blood helps transfer the body heat out to the air.
words.example_zh: 循环的血液会促进体内的热量散到体外。
words.notes: [记] circulation n. 流通，循环；传播

words.example_en: Clouds usually precipitate as rain or snow.
words.example_zh: 云常会凝结成雨或雪。
words.notes: [记] precipitation n. 沉淀；降水量；陡然下落

words.example_en: This reservoir gives water to the whole city.
words.example_zh: 这座水库为全城提供用水。

words.example_en: They were filled with wonder at the new waterfall.
words.example_zh: 他们对新瀑布感到非常惊奇。

words.example_en: Social life is the fountain of wisdom for writers.
words.example_zh: 社会生活是作家们智慧的源泉。

words.example_en: It can be quite windy there, especially in spring.
words.example_zh: 那里的天气相当多风，特别是在春季。
words.notes: [记] springtime n. 春季，春天

words.example_en: Dew dripped from the leaves.
words.example_zh: 露水从叶子上滴下来。

words.example_en: Tears poured from her eyes.
words.example_zh: 泪水从她眼中涌出。
words.notes: [记] downpour n. 倾盆大雨

words.meaning_zh: v. 排空；（使）流出；n. 耗竭
words.example_en: They drain the swamp and turn it into fertile land.
words.example_zh: 他们排干沼泽地的水，将它变成了肥沃的土地。
words.word_formation: 词源同 dry（adj. 干的）。
words.notes: [记] drainage n. 排水；排水装置

words.example_en: Be careful! Your paintbrush is dripping.
words.example_zh: 小心！你的漆刷正在往下滴漆。
words.collocations: [搭] drip down 滴下
words.notes: drip 和 drop 都是象声词——仔细听一听雨滴落在地上的声音。

words.example_en: She attempted to drown herself in the river.
words.example_zh: 她企图投河自尽。

words.meaning_zh: v. 吹；（风）吹；吹动；n. 用力的一击；打击，挫折
words.example_en: Now, Peter, make a wish and blow out the candles.
words.example_zh: 彼得，现在许个愿，然后吹灭蜡烛。
words.collocations: [搭] strike a blow for 维护（某种信念、原则等）

words.meaning_zh: v. 喷出；喘息；n.（吹出的）一股，一缕
words.example_en: Don't puff cigarette smoke in my face.
words.example_zh: 不要向我脸上喷烟。

words.example_en: In a moment more, the crowd began to gush forth from the doors of the church.
words.example_zh: 过了一会儿，人群便开始从教堂的几扇门里蜂拥而出。
words.collocations: [搭] gush out 涌出，喷出；gush from 从……喷出

words.example_en: There will be dense fog in northern parts of the country tomorrow.
words.example_zh: 该国北部地区明天将有浓雾。
words.notes: [记] density n. 密度

words.example_en: I was surprised by the intensity of his anxiety.
words.example_zh: 我对他的强烈焦虑感到吃惊。
words.notes: [记] intense adj. 强烈的；紧张的

words.example_en: Intensive care in hospitals is given to the seriously ill.
words.example_zh: 在医院里，危重病人会得到加强护理。
words.collocations: [搭] intensive care unit (ICU) 重症监护室
words.notes: [记] intense adj. 剧烈的，强烈的；intensively adv. 深入地，密集地

words.meaning_zh: 浮现，露出；摆脱出来；暴露
words.example_en: The sun emerged from behind the clouds.
words.example_zh: 太阳从云后面露出来。
words.collocations: [搭] emerge out of 从……里出来
words.word_formation: e（向外）+ merge（浸没）→ 浮现。

words.meaning_zh: v.（使）闪光；（使）闪现；（通过计算机、卫星等）快速发送；n. 闪光（灯）；闪现
words.example_en: The good news was flashed across the country.
words.example_zh: 这个好消息迅速传遍全国。
words.collocations: [搭] flash through sb.'s mind 闪过某人的脑海

words.example_en: The smell of roses floated around.
words.example_zh: 玫瑰花的芳香在四周飘荡。

words.meaning_zh: 自然环境；环境，周围状况
words.example_en: An increasing number of people are concerned about the pollution of the environment.
words.example_zh: 越来越多的人关心环境污染问题。
words.notes: [记] environmental adj. 自然环境保护的；有关环境的

words.example_en: The polluted waste is often dumped unceremoniously, making the surrounding land infertile.
words.example_zh: 被污染的废料经常被随意倒掉，周边土地因此变得贫瘠。
words.collocations: [搭] surrounding environment 周围环境

words.example_en: I had almost decided to accept their conditions at that time.
words.example_zh: 当时，我差不多已决定要接受他们的条件了。
words.collocations: [搭] accept a condition 接受条件

words.example_en: Due to poor management, they finally got into a difficult financial situation.
words.example_zh: 由于管理不善，他们最终陷入财政困境。
words.collocations: [搭] in this situation 在这种场合/形势/情况下
words.notes: [记] situate v. 使坐落于，使位于

words.example_en: In fact, nature is much better at recycling than we humans are.
words.example_zh: 事实上，自然界在循环利用方面比人类做得好很多。
words.collocations: [搭] destroy nature 破坏大自然

words.example_en: It is natural that he should fall in love with such a beautiful girl.
words.example_zh: 他爱上如此美丽的姑娘，这是很自然的事。
words.notes: [记] naturally adv. 自然地；天然地

words.example_en: This fruit juice contains absolutely no artificial flavourings or colourings.
words.example_zh: 这种果汁绝不含人造调味品或色素。
words.word_formation: 字根 art 意为“技巧（skill）；技艺（art）”；字根 fic 等同于字根 fact，意为“制作（to make）”。同字根的单词例如：artefact（用技艺制作出来的物品，非天然的 → 人造物品；手工艺品），factory（制作的地方 → 工厂）。

words.meaning_zh: adj. 人造的，合成的；n. [~s] 合成物
words.example_en: Nylon is a synthetic material; it is not from nature.
words.example_zh: 尼龙是一种合成材料，不是天然物质。

words.example_en: My new car really eats up petrol.
words.example_zh: 我的新汽车真是太耗油了。

words.example_en: There are reports that some gas stations have run out of gas.
words.example_zh: 有报道称，一些加油站的汽油已经用光了。
words.collocations: [搭] a gas station 加油站

words.example_en: The price of gasoline is unstable.
words.example_zh: 汽油价格不稳定。

words.example_en: Petroleum is an important natural resource.
words.example_zh: 石油是一种重要的自然资源。
words.word_formation: 字根 petr 指“石头”，如：petrology（岩石学）。
words.notes: 记得 surprise, amaze, astonish, astound 这些表示“使惊奇”的词吗？要表达最高程度的“惊奇”，就用 petrify（v.［使］石化；使吓呆）。

words.example_en: The algae capture the sun's energy by photosynthesis and store it in organic molecules.
words.example_zh: 水藻通过光合作用获得太阳的能量，将它储存在有机分子中。
words.word_formation: 前缀 photo 表示“光（light）”，故该单词的结构是：photo（光）+ synthesis（合成）→ 用光合成 → 光合作用。又如 photograph（照片）：photo（光）+ graph（写，画）→ 用光来描绘。

words.example_en: Plants respire in the same way as animals, taking in oxygen and giving out carbon dioxide.
words.example_zh: 植物和动物的呼吸方式相同，即摄入氧气并释放二氧化碳。
words.notes: [记] respiration n. 呼吸；respiratory adj. 呼吸的

words.example_en: Plants can absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen.
words.example_zh: 植物可以吸收二氧化碳并释放氧气。
words.collocations: [搭] carbon dioxide 二氧化碳
words.word_formation: di（二）+ oxide（氧化物）→ 二氧化物。

words.example_en: There is not much vegetation in deserts.
words.example_zh: 沙漠中的植物不多。
words.notes: [记] vegetable n. 蔬菜；vegetarian n. 素食者

words.example_en: There is a herb garden behind the house.
words.example_zh: 屋后有一个芳草园。
words.notes: [记] herbal adj. 药草的；香草的；herbivore n. 食草动物；carnivore n. 食肉动物

words.meaning_zh: n. 多年生植物；adj. 长期的，持久的
words.example_en: These perennials should be planted where they can naturalise.
words.example_zh: 应该将这些多年生植物种在它们能适应的环境中。

words.example_en: He was involved in the structural botany.
words.example_zh: 他潜心于研究结构植物学。
words.notes: [记] botanical adj. 植物的；植物学的；botanist n. 植物学家

words.example_en: I am interested in the ecology of the desert.
words.example_zh: 我对沙漠的生态感兴趣。
words.notes: [记] ecological adj. 生态学的；生态的；ecologist n. 生态学家

words.example_en: Water is the core of a healthy ecosystem.
words.example_zh: 水是生态系统保持良好状态的核心要素。
words.word_formation: eco（生态）+ system（系统）→ 生态系统。

words.meaning_zh: 对生态环境友好的，不妨害生态环境的
words.example_en: Attention to eco-friendly packaging is increasing.
words.example_zh: 对生态友好型包装的关注度日益提高。
words.notes: [记] user-friendly adj. 便于使用的

words.example_en: Horticulture is the industry and science of plant cultivation.
words.example_zh: 园艺是关于植物栽培的产业和科学。

words.example_en: This insect behaves like a parasite—an organism that lives on or in another organism called a host.
words.example_zh: 这种昆虫的行为像寄生虫，即一种生活在被称为“宿主”的另一个生物身上或体内的生物。
words.notes: [记] organ n. 器官

words.example_en: In genetics, genes were formerly called factors.
words.example_zh: 在遗传学上，基因以前被称为因子。
words.notes: [记] gene n. 基因；genetic adj. 基因的

words.example_en: The mutations in plants caused by radiation have been found in experiments.
words.example_zh: 已有实验发现辐射引起的植物变异。
words.notes: [记] mutate v. 改变；（使）突变；mutant n. 突变体

words.example_en: Variation among dogs is limited to the possible permutations of their genes.
words.example_zh: 狗的变异受限于其基因可能存在的排列组合方式。
words.notes: [记] vary v. 变化

words.example_en: This place used to be a flourishing forest with regional diversity.
words.example_zh: 这里曾是一片有着区域多样性的繁茂森林。
words.notes: [记] diverse adj. 不同的，多种多样的；biodiversity n. 生物多样性

words.example_en: Somatic cell hybridisation is a very useful technique.
words.example_zh: 体细胞杂交是一种很实用的技术。

words.example_en: The tape would self-destruct in twenty minutes.
words.example_zh: 这盘磁带会在20分钟后自毁。
words.notes: [记] destruction n. 破坏

words.meaning_zh: v. 毁坏，摧毁；n. 毁灭；废墟
words.example_en: The storm ruined the crops.
words.example_zh: 暴风雨毁坏了庄稼。

words.example_en: Flowers perish when frost comes.
words.example_zh: 霜冻一来，花即凋零。
words.notes: 西方学术界有一句很有名的话：“Publish or Perish!” 指的是从事研究的人，如果不能高效地在规定的期刊杂志上持续发表足够数量的论文或学术文章，就无法维持或推进其学术生涯。

words.example_en: The fire demolished the town.
words.example_zh: 大火烧毁了这座城镇。

words.example_en: The press infringed a copyright agreement.
words.example_zh: 这家出版社违反了一项版权协议。
words.notes: [记] fringe 指“边缘”，可以把 infringe 想象成从外面走到了边界里面，破坏了边缘，形成了侵犯行为；说明续排在下一页顶部。

words.example_en: The constant criticism was beginning to undermine her confidence.
words.example_zh: 持续的批评开始逐渐削弱她的自信。

words.example_en: By 2050, a quarter of the earth's species could be threatened with extinction.
words.example_zh: 到2050年，地球上四分之一的物种可能会灭绝。
words.notes: [记] extinct adj. 已灭绝的

words.example_en: Training and education follow different patterns in different regions.
words.example_zh: 培训和教育在不同的地区遵循不同的模式。
words.collocations: [搭] a dress pattern 衣服的底样

words.example_en: We are anxiously awaiting the outcome of their discussion.
words.example_zh: 我们急切地等待着他们讨论的结果。

words.example_en: We are a flash in time, but our impact is forever.
words.example_zh: 我们只是时间长河中的一瞬闪光，但我们的影响是永恒的。
words.collocations: [搭] have an impact on 对……有影响

words.example_en: The greatest seasonal change on our planet is now under way.
words.example_zh: 地球上最精彩的季节性变化现正在上演。

words.example_en: There is no cure or vaccine, but some patients have been given experimental treatments.
words.example_zh: 没有任何治疗方法或疫苗，但是一些病人接受了试验性治疗。

words.example_en: It's encouraging to receive a favourable report on one's study.
words.example_zh: 在学习中获得肯定性的反馈，这是令人鼓舞的。

words.example_en: Once the plants have produced fruit, they become less productive.
words.example_zh: 一旦结出果实，这些植物就变得少产了。

words.example_en: These are effective measures.
words.example_zh: 这些都是有效的措施。
words.notes: [记] effect n. 效应；结果

words.example_en: This new copy machine is more efficient than the old one.
words.example_zh: 这台新复印机比那台旧的效率高。

words.example_en: It is a considerable sum of money.
words.example_zh: 那是一笔数量可观的钱。

words.meaning_zh: 巨大的，大规模的，庞大的
words.example_en: There are massive mineral resources in the west part of China.
words.example_zh: 中国西部地区有着大量的矿产资源。
words.notes: [记] mass n. 团；大量；massively adv. 大规模地

words.example_en: They plunged into their work with immense zeal.
words.example_zh: 他们以极大的热情投入工作。

words.example_en: She obtained maximal benefit from the course.
words.example_zh: 她从该课程中获益极大。

words.example_en: I stayed with friends, so my expenses were minimal.
words.example_zh: 我住在朋友家，所以我的花费极小。

words.example_en: This is the optimal season for the growth of plants.
words.example_zh: 这是植物生长的最佳季节。

words.example_en: The biologist brought out a specimen box and showed the items one by one.
words.example_zh: 生物学家拿出标本箱，一件一件地展示着标本。
words.notes: [记] biology n. 生物学

words.example_en: The zoologist had spent a long time living with monkeys.
words.example_zh: 这位动物学家与猴子一起生活了很长时间。
words.notes: [记] zoology n. 动物学

words.example_en: A contemporary ecologist once said: man lives on the earth as a guest of green plants.
words.example_zh: 一位当代生态学家曾说：人类是作为绿色植物的客人生活在地球上的。
words.notes: [记] ecology n. 生态学

words.example_en: The botanist discovered many rare plants.
words.example_zh: 这个植物学家发现了许多稀有植物。
words.notes: [记] botany n. 植物学

words.example_en: Human beings also belong to the mammal species.
words.example_zh: 人类也属于哺乳动物。

words.example_en: Compared to body size, the primate brain is larger than that of other animals.
words.example_zh: 相对身躯大小而言，灵长目动物的大脑比其他动物的大脑都要大些。

words.example_en: Fish, birds and human beings are all vertebrates.
words.example_zh: 鱼、鸟和人类都是脊椎动物。

words.example_en: It is said that he hates reptiles.
words.example_zh: 据说他讨厌爬行动物。

words.meaning_zh: n. 两栖动物；水陆两用车；adj. 两栖动物的；水陆两用的
words.example_en: Nobody knows why amphibians are disappearing, dolphins are dying and coral is turning white.
words.example_zh: 没有人知道为什么两栖动物正在消失，海豚正在死亡，珊瑚正在变成白色。

words.example_en: Lions and tigers are carnivores.
words.example_zh: 狮子和老虎是食肉动物。
words.word_formation: 字根 carn 表示“肉（flesh）”，vore 表示“吞食（to devour）”。类似地，herbivore（食草动物）中的字根 herb 表示“草（grass）”，folivore（食叶动物）中的字根 foli 表示“叶（foliage）”。
words.notes: 含有 carn 的词又如：carnation（康乃馨），大多是粉红色的，即肉色的；大家熟悉的 carnival（狂欢节），也被译为“嘉年华”（根据单词的粤语读音直译），原指基督徒在为期40天的大斋期前的节日（有观点认为该词来源于表示“告别肉食”的中世纪欧洲拉丁语）。

words.example_en: Pandas are classified as carnivores but they mainly have a diet of an herbivore.
words.example_zh: 大熊猫被归为食肉动物，但它们的日常主要饮食像食草动物。

words.example_en: The crocodile is a strange-looking creature.
words.example_zh: 鳄鱼是一种模样古怪的动物。

words.example_en: Environmental pollution endangers wildlife.
words.example_zh: 环境污染威胁着野生生物的生存。
words.notes: [记] wild adj. 野生的

words.example_en: The park is also home to grizzly bears, and other Rocky Mountain faunas.
words.example_zh: 这个国家公园也是灰熊和落基山脉其他动物群的家园。

words.example_en: There they compiled precious documents on the manners, government, religion, fauna and flora of the country.
words.example_zh: 他们在那里汇编了关于这个国家的风俗、政府、宗教、动植物等方面的宝贵资料。
words.notes: 源自罗马神话中的花神弗罗拉（Flora）。她嫁给了西风之神，丈夫送给她一座满是奇花异草的园子。春天时，弗罗拉和丈夫会手挽手在园子里漫步，他们一路上走过的地方百花齐放。英文单词 flower, flour, flourish, floral, florist 和美国的 Florida 州都和她有关系。类似地，表示“（尤指某一地区的）动物群”的单词 fauna 源自罗马神话中保佑森林、农田和畜牧业的女神浮娜（Fauna）。

words.example_en: Some species of animals have become extinct because they could not adapt to a changing environment.
words.example_zh: 有些动物物种已经灭绝，因为它们不能适应环境的变化。

words.example_en: Sheep usually flock together.
words.example_zh: 羊通常是结群的。

words.example_en: The herdsman looks after a herd of animals.
words.example_zh: 牧人照管着一群牲畜。
words.notes: [记] herdsman n. 牧人

words.meaning_zh: （蜜蜂等昆虫的）一大群；（迅速移动的）人群
words.example_en: I saw a swarm of bees attacking the poor monkey.
words.example_zh: 我看到一群蜜蜂正在攻击可怜的猴子。
words.notes: 例句跨栏排版。

words.meaning_zh: n. 人群，一大群人；v. 群集
words.example_en: He was met by a throng of journalists and photographers.
words.example_zh: 他受到一大群记者和摄影师的迎接。
words.collocations: [搭] be thronged with 被（人、汽车等）挤满

words.example_en: The crowd was very well behaved.
words.example_zh: 那群人的举止非常得体。

words.example_en: The hunters blocked up the den of the beast.
words.example_zh: 猎人们堵住了兽穴。
words.notes: 迪士尼动画片《美女与野兽》的英文原名是 Beauty and the Beast。

words.example_en: We all want to punish the brute.
words.example_zh: 我们都想惩罚那个残忍的人。

words.example_en: The death of their daughter was a cruel blow.
words.example_zh: 女儿的死对他们是一个残酷的打击。

words.example_en: The use of the computer has originated many other societal reforms.
words.example_zh: 电脑的使用引发了其他许多社会革新。
words.collocations: [搭] originate from 来源于
words.notes: [记] origin n. 起源，发源

words.example_en: I derived a lot of pleasure from meeting new people at college.
words.example_zh: 在大学里，我从结识新朋友中得到许多乐趣。
words.collocations: [搭] derive from / be derived from 源自，来自

words.meaning_zh: v. 起源于，来自；n. 茎，梗
words.example_en: Correct decisions stem from correct judgments.
words.example_zh: 正确的决定来源于正确的判断。
words.collocations: [搭] stem from 源自，起源于

words.example_en: Lions and house cats evolved from a common ancestor.
words.example_zh: 狮子和家猫是由同一个祖先进化而来的。
words.word_formation: an（在前）+ cess（走）+ or（后缀，表示人）→ 走在历史前方的人 → 祖先。
words.notes: [记] ancient adj. 古代的；古老的

words.meaning_zh: n. 后裔，后代；adj. 下降的
words.example_en: He is a descendant of Queen Victoria.
words.example_zh: 他是维多利亚女王的后代。
words.notes: [记] descend v. 下降

words.meaning_zh: [单复数同形] 后代，子孙；产物
words.example_en: They have two offspring.
words.example_zh: 他们有两个子女。

words.example_en: According to a subgroup analysis, violence produces more violence.
words.example_zh: 一份子群分析显示，暴力会导致更多的暴力。

words.example_en: He has to work hard to feed and clothe his family.
words.example_zh: 他必须努力工作以供给全家吃穿。
words.collocations: [搭] feed on 以……为食物，以……为生

words.meaning_zh: v. 饲养；繁殖；n. 品种
words.example_en: She breeds orchids in her greenhouse.
words.example_zh: 她在她的温室里培育兰花。
words.notes: [记] breeding n. 饲养；繁殖

words.example_en: Fish of different shapes are difficult to interbreed.
words.example_zh: 不同形态的鱼很难杂交。

words.example_en: Immediately, rose breeders began to hybridise it with other red roses.
words.example_zh: 玫瑰培育者们马上开始让该品种与其他红玫瑰杂交。
words.notes: [记] hybrid n. 杂种，杂交生成的生物体

words.example_en: Microbes proliferate rapidly.
words.example_zh: 微生物迅速增殖。

words.example_en: This disease causes sterility in both males and females.
words.example_zh: 该病会导致男女不孕不育。

words.example_en: Many animals mate in the spring.
words.example_zh: 许多动物在春天交配。
words.notes: [记] mating n. 交配

words.example_en: They attract females with elaborate courtship rituals.
words.example_zh: 它们用复杂的求偶仪式来吸引雌性。

words.example_en: They lay eggs from the beginning of July to the middle of August.
words.example_zh: 它们在7月初到8月中这段时间产卵。

words.example_en: Don't count the chickens before they are hatched.
words.example_zh: 鸡蛋还未孵，别忙数鸡雏。

words.meaning_zh: n. 一窝幼鸟；v. 孵（蛋）
words.example_en: The bird was trying to find food for its brood.
words.example_zh: 鸟儿在为它的一窝小鸟觅食。

words.meaning_zh: n.（鱼、蛙等的）卵；v. 产卵；引起
words.example_en: Many sea fishes spawn in rivers.
words.example_zh: 许多海洋鱼类是在河里产卵的。
words.notes: “再生侠”（Spawn）在欧美国家是一个家喻户晓的名字。他与蜘蛛侠（Spiderman）、蝙蝠侠（Batman）、超人（Superman）等漫画人物齐名。

words.example_en: You are a mature man now; you are no longer a boy.
words.example_zh: 你现在是成熟的男人了，不再是小男孩了。
words.notes: [记] immature adj. 不成熟的，未完全发展的

words.example_en: When he fell, he just broke the skin.
words.example_zh: 当他跌倒时，他只擦破了皮肤。

words.example_en: A hen's claw has four toes.
words.example_zh: 母鸡的脚爪有四个脚趾。

words.example_en: This is a black cat with white paws.
words.example_zh: 这是一只长有白色脚爪的黑猫。

words.example_en: The bird picked a hole in the ice with its beak.
words.example_zh: 那只鸟用喙在冰上啄出了一个洞。

words.example_en: In the future, shark fin soup will be off the menu at a major resort in Singapore.
words.example_zh: 未来，鱼翅羹将不再出现在新加坡一主要度假地的菜单上。

words.example_en: A seagull fluttered down with an injured wing.
words.example_zh: 一只海鸥带着一只受伤的翅膀飞落下来。

words.example_en: This is the long plume of a heron in the breeding season.
words.example_zh: 这是处在繁殖季节的一只鹭的长羽毛。

words.example_en: A feather is very light, so that we say “(as) light as a feather”.
words.example_zh: 羽毛很轻，因此我们说“轻如羽毛”（形容重量、脚步等极轻）。

words.meaning_zh: （动物的）软毛；（用于制衣等的）毛皮
words.example_en: Alice is allergic to the fur of cats.
words.example_zh: 艾丽斯对猫毛过敏。

words.example_en: The brush is made of animal bristles.
words.example_zh: 这把刷子是用动物的鬃毛制成的。

words.meaning_zh: n. 鬈发；卷曲；螺旋状物；v.（使）卷曲
words.example_en: As he got older, his hair lost its curl.
words.example_zh: 随着他渐渐长大，他的头发不再卷曲了。

words.example_en: The insect bit him and drew blood from his arm.
words.example_zh: 那只昆虫叮咬了他并在他的手臂上吸血。
words.notes: 字根 sect 指“切割（to cut）”，如：insect（躯体分割成一节一节的→昆虫），sect（派别；教派；党派），bisect（将……分为二），intersection（相互切割，纵横切割→交叉；十字路口），vivisect（切割活的东西→活体解剖）。

words.example_en: The worm was crushed under the feet.
words.example_zh: 这条虫子被脚踩扁了。

words.example_en: Insects which eat crops are pests.
words.example_zh: 吃庄稼的昆虫是害虫。
words.collocations: [搭] the pest of society 社会败类
words.notes: [记] pesticide n. 杀虫剂

words.example_en: The life of the parasite is maintained by new blood-sucking mosquitoes.
words.example_zh: 新出现的吸血蚊子让寄生虫的生命得以维持。
words.notes: [记] parasitic adj. 寄生的

words.example_en: The little girl thinks spiders are terrible creatures.
words.example_zh: 小女孩认为蜘蛛是可怕的生物。
words.collocations: [搭] a spider's web 蜘蛛网

words.example_en: A butterfly is flying up and down among the flowers.
words.example_zh: 一只蝴蝶正在花丛里忽上忽下地飞着。
words.collocations: [搭] a social butterfly 交际花

words.example_en: The mosquito is an annoying creature.
words.example_zh: 蚊子是一种讨厌的生物。

words.example_en: A cricket in the house is good luck.
words.example_zh: 屋里有蟋蟀会带来好运。

words.example_en: The penguin is popular with people.
words.example_zh: 企鹅广为人爱。

words.meaning_zh: n. 海豹；封条；图章；v. 密封
words.example_en: Polar bears set off in search of their favourite meal—seals.
words.example_zh: 北极熊出发去寻找它们最喜欢的食物——海豹。

words.example_en: Do you remember the story about a race between the tortoise and the hare?
words.example_zh: 你们还记得那个关于龟兔赛跑的故事么？

words.example_en: If you turn over a turtle on its back, it will become helpless.
words.example_zh: 假如你把海龟翻过来，它就无能为力了。

words.meaning_zh: n. 鲸鱼；v. 捕鲸；猛击
words.example_en: We may live to see the extinction of the whale.
words.example_zh: 我们或许能亲眼见到鲸的灭绝。
words.notes: 常见的鲸鱼有蓝鲸（blue whale）和抹香鲸（sperm whale）等。抹香鲸的体内可产生极为珍贵的可用作药材和香料的物质龙涎香（ambergris）。

words.example_en: The kangaroo is native to Australia.
words.example_zh: 袋鼠原产于澳大利亚。

words.example_en: The merchant decided to use camels to carry his goods across the desert.
words.example_zh: 商人决定用骆驼载运其货物穿过沙漠。

words.example_en: Pandas are loved by people all over the world.
words.example_zh: 熊猫被全世界的人喜爱。

words.example_en: A specific attribute of the elephant is its long trunk.
words.example_zh: 大象的一个特有特征是它的长鼻子。

words.example_en: The elephant's trunk is powerful enough to uproot trees.
words.example_zh: 大象的鼻子有足够力量把树连根拔起。

words.example_en: The professor lived in an ivory tower.
words.example_zh: 这个教授生活在象牙塔中。

words.example_en: The young goat was just beginning to grow horns.
words.example_zh: 这只小山羊刚开始长角。
words.collocations: [搭] blow a horn 吹号角

words.example_en: The bear is a large, heavy animal with thick fur.
words.example_zh: 熊是体大而笨重、皮毛很厚的动物。
words.collocations: [搭] a polar bear 北极熊

words.example_en: The wolf snapped at the hunter's hand.
words.example_zh: 这匹狼咬住猎人的手。
words.collocations: [搭] a wolf in sheep's clothing 披着羊皮的狼

words.example_en: Dragons are described as monsters in most western countries.
words.example_zh: 在大多数西方国家，龙被描述为怪物。

words.example_en: Don't trust him; he is a sly old fox.
words.example_zh: 别相信他，他是个狡猾的老狐狸。

words.example_en: The cub licked the milk from its mother's breast.
words.example_zh: 这头幼兽吸吮着妈妈的奶水。

words.example_en: Did you see the cow with her calf?
words.example_zh: 你看没看见那头母牛和它的小牛？

words.example_en: I'll get you an Alsatian pup for Christmas.
words.example_zh: 我会送你一只小德国牧羊犬作为圣诞节礼物。
words.notes: [记] puppy n. 幼犬

words.example_en: The little lamb was caught by the wolf.
words.example_zh: 小羊被狼抓住了。
words.collocations: [搭] a lost lamb 迷途羔羊

words.example_en: There are many herds of cattle in the meadow.
words.example_zh: 牧场上有许多牛群。

words.example_en: The frequent, unreasonable whips angered the ox.
words.example_zh: 这种频繁而无理的鞭打激怒了公牛。
words.notes: [记] 复数形式：oxen

words.example_en: He was a great bull of a man.
words.example_zh: 他是一个体壮如牛的人。

words.example_en: There were lots of buffaloes in the North America 100 years ago.
words.example_zh: 100年前，北美有大量野牛。

words.example_en: The horse became frightened and ran away.
words.example_zh: 那匹马受到惊吓并跑开了。
words.collocations: [搭] put the cart before the horse 本末倒置

words.example_en: There are several species of zebra.
words.example_zh: 有好几种斑马。

words.example_en: The donkey is eating grass on the field.
words.example_zh: 这头驴子正在田野上吃草。

words.example_en: He was putting a saddle on the horse.
words.example_zh: 他正在给马备鞍。
words.collocations: [搭] get into the saddle 上马

words.example_en: You cannot judge a horse by its harness.
words.example_zh: 凭马具难断马优劣。
words.collocations: [搭] in harness 通力合作，相互配合

words.example_en: His falcon flew into a window of the empty castle and did not return.
words.example_zh: 他的猎鹰飞进了那座空城堡的一扇窗内就未返回。

words.example_en: A hawk hovered in the blue sky.
words.example_zh: 一只鹰在蓝色的天空中盘旋。

words.example_en: The eagle dived down on the rabbit.
words.example_zh: 那只雕向兔子猛扑下来。
words.notes: [记] eagle-eyed adj. 目光锐利的，观察敏锐的

words.example_en: The owl is sacred for many Californian Indian people.
words.example_zh: 对于加利福尼亚的很多印第安人而言，猫头鹰是神圣的。

words.example_en: There are many swallows flying in the sky.
words.example_zh: 天空中有许多燕子在飞。

words.example_en: A sparrow is very alert in its movement.
words.example_zh: 麻雀的动作很敏捷。

words.example_en: An old man sat on the park bench and fed the pigeons.
words.example_zh: 一位老人坐在公园的长凳上喂鸽子。

words.example_en: The farmers tried to fear the crows out of the corn field by planting several men of straw.
words.example_zh: 农民们竖起了几个稻草人，试图把乌鸦从玉米地里吓跑。
words.notes: 书中例句保留为 “fear the crows out of the corn field”，未按常见表达改写。

words.example_en: The witch turned the princess into a swan.
words.example_zh: 巫婆把公主变成了一只天鹅。
words.collocations: [搭] sb.'s swan song 某人最后的作品，某人的告别演出

words.example_en: They often have goose at Christmastime.
words.example_zh: 他们常常在圣诞节吃鹅肉。

words.example_en: The cock has brighter coloured feathers than the hen.
words.example_zh: 雄鸟的羽毛比雌鸟的艳丽。

words.example_en: The cat was playing with a live mouse.
words.example_zh: 这只猫在逗一只活老鼠。

words.example_en: Now I can see why people say he is such a rat.
words.example_zh: 现在我知道为什么人们说他是卑鄙小人了。

words.example_en: The squirrel ran up a tree and got out of my reach.
words.example_zh: 松鼠跑到树上去了，我逮不着。

words.example_en: The hunter watched for the hare to come out of the burrow.
words.example_zh: 猎人守候着野兔，等它从洞里出来。

words.example_en: A frog can live both on land and in water.
words.example_zh: 青蛙既能生活在陆地上，也能生活在水中。

words.example_en: They observed the behaviour of their new pet.
words.example_zh: 他们观察新宠物的行为习惯。
words.notes: [记] behavioural (= behavioral) adj. 行为的

words.example_en: The mosquitoes are biting me.
words.example_zh: 蚊子在叮我。
words.collocations:
[搭] bite off more than one can chew 贪多嚼不烂
bite the bullet 咬紧牙关应付

words.meaning_zh: v. 刺，叮；（使）感觉刺痛；n. 刺，蜇针；蛰痛
words.example_en: It is the nature of the scorpion to sting.
words.example_zh: 蛰人是蝎子的天性。
words.collocations: [搭] sting sb. into doing sth. 刺激某人做某事

words.meaning_zh: v.（狗等）吠；大声嚷；n. 树皮
words.example_en: Barking dogs seldom bite.
words.example_zh: 善吠的狗很少咬人。

words.example_en: The whole room rang with a roar.
words.example_zh: 咆哮声回荡在整个房间里。

words.meaning_zh: v. 擦；摩擦；n. 困难，障碍
words.example_en: It is an Eskimo custom to rub noses as a greeting.
words.example_zh: 相互摩擦鼻子以示问候是爱斯基摩人的习俗。

words.example_en: We take off our shoes and creep cautiously along the passage.
words.example_zh: 我们脱掉了鞋，小心地在走廊中踮手踮脚地往前走。
words.collocations: [搭] creep along 沿着……爬行

words.example_en: You must not crawl into the favour of your superiors.
words.example_zh: 你不应卑躬屈膝地讨好你的上司。

words.example_en: The Arctic region is the habitat of the polar bear.
words.example_zh: 北极地区为北极熊的栖息地。
words.notes: [记] inhabitant n. 居民；栖息动物

words.example_en: The male hunts for food while his mate guards the nest.
words.example_zh: 雌性动物守巢时，雄性动物去猎食。

words.meaning_zh: n. 蜂房；繁忙的场所；v.（使）（蜂）入蜂箱；（像蜜蜂般）密集群居
words.example_en: This marketplace was once a hive of activity.
words.example_zh: 这个市场一度是一个繁忙的闹市。

words.meaning_zh: 蜂房巢室；细胞；单人牢房
words.example_en: The prisoner was locked in a cell.
words.example_zh: 那个囚犯被关在单人牢房内。
words.notes: [记] cellular adj. 细胞的

words.example_en: The lion paced the floor of his cage restlessly.
words.example_zh: 狮子烦躁地在兽笼里走来走去。

words.meaning_zh: n. 马厩；牛棚；adj. 稳定的；稳固的
words.example_en: The horse in the stable has broken out.
words.example_zh: 马厩里的那匹马跑了。
words.word_formation: 源自拉丁语 stare，意为“站”→马站立的地方；能站稳→马厩；稳定的。
words.notes: 例句和词源说明跨页排版。

words.example_en: The cows were feeding on hay in the barn.
words.example_zh: 母牛正在牲口棚里吃草。

words.example_en: There is an opening in the hedge.
words.example_zh: 这树篱上有个洞。
words.collocations: [搭] on the hedge 抱骑墙态度的

words.example_en: Lack of confidence is the biggest barrier to the improvement of your English.
words.example_zh: 缺乏信心是你提高英语水平的最大障碍。

words.example_en: A bar of chocolate is enough to stop his crying.
words.example_zh: 一条巧克力就可以让他不哭了。

words.example_en: We have to do anatomy next term.
words.example_zh: 我们下学期得学解剖学了。
words.notes:
[记] anatomical adj. 解剖的；解剖学的
anatomist n. 解剖学家

words.meaning_zh: n. 流行病；（坏事的）盛行；adj. 流行性的；极为盛行的
words.example_en: Violence is reaching epidemic levels in some of the films and TV shows.
words.example_zh: 在一些电影和电视剧中，暴力已经快到泛滥程度了。
words.collocations: [搭] control an epidemic 控制流行病

words.example_en: You have good genes from your parents, so you should live a long time.
words.example_zh: 你从父母那儿获得了优良的基因，所以应当能够活得很长。
words.collocations: [搭] gene pool 基因库
words.notes: [记] genetic adj. 遗传（性）的，基因的；起源的

words.example_en: Disinfectants are used to kill germs.
words.example_zh: 消毒剂被用来杀死细菌。

words.example_en: Bacteria in drinking water have spread the illness.
words.example_zh: 饮水中的细菌传播了该疾病。

words.example_en: My computer was accidentally infected with a virus called "Trojan Horse".
words.example_zh: 我的电脑不小心感染了一种被称作“木马”的病毒。

words.example_en: Would the good microbes do battle with the bad microbes and help to restore their health?
words.example_zh: 这些好的微生物会不会与坏的微生物斗争，从而帮助患者恢复健康呢？
words.word_formation: micro（微小）+ be（= bi 生命）→ 微小的生命 → 微生物。
words.notes: [记] microbiology n. 微生物学  microbial adj. 微生物（或细菌）的；由微生物（或细菌）引起的

words.example_en: Some people's metabolism is more efficient than others.
words.example_zh: 某些人的代谢效率要比另一些人更高。
words.notes:
[记] metabolise (= metabolize) v. 新陈代谢
metabolic adj. 新陈代谢的

words.example_en: You need more protein to build you up.
words.example_zh: 你需要增加蛋白质以增强体质。
words.notes: 例句跨页排版。

words.example_en: Fresh green foodstuffs contain rich vitamin.
words.example_zh: 新鲜的绿色蔬菜含有丰富的维生素。
words.word_formation: 由意为“生命”的字根 vita 和单词 amine（胺）结合形成，因为最初造这个词的生化学家认为维生素是胺类。同根词如 vital（生命的；必不可少的）。相关字根 viv 表示“活”，如：vivid（鲜活的，生动的），revive（复活），survive（幸存，活下来）。

words.example_en: The kidneys secrete urine.
words.example_zh: 肾脏会分泌尿液。
words.notes: [记] secret n. 秘密

words.example_en: The function of the kidneys is to excrete waste products.
words.example_zh: 肾脏的功能是排泄代谢废物。
words.notes: [记] excretion n. 排泄；排泄物

words.example_en: The lion devoured the deer.
words.example_zh: 狮子狼吞虎咽地把鹿吃了下去。
words.word_formation: de（加强意义）+ vour（吃）→ 整个吃下去→吞食。

words.example_en: Don't trust anything except your instinct.
words.example_zh: 你只能相信你的直觉。
words.collocations: [搭] follow one's instincts 凭某人的直觉
words.notes: [记] instinctive adj. 本能的，天生的；直觉的

words.example_en: He seemed to have an intuitive knowledge of how I was feeling.
words.example_zh: 他好像能凭直觉知道我的感受。
words.notes: [记] intuition n. 直觉

words.example_en: She showed great potential as an actress.
words.example_zh: 她表现出了成为演员的极大潜力。

words.example_en: Use your intelligence, and you're sure to succeed some day.
words.example_zh: 发挥你的聪明才智，总有一天你一定会成功。
words.collocations:
[搭] an intelligence agent 情报人员
artificial intelligence (AI) 人工智能
words.notes: [记] intelligent adj. 聪明的，有才智的

words.example_en: What are the functional benefits of the brand?
words.example_zh: 这个品牌在功能方面有什么好处？
words.notes: [记] function n. 功能 v. 起作用

words.meaning_zh: 灵敏的；过敏的；易担忧的；（话题等）须谨慎对待的
words.example_en: She is sensitive to what people think of her.
words.example_zh: 她对人们对她的看法是很敏感的。
words.collocations: [搭] be sensitive to 对……敏感；对……过敏
words.notes: [记] sense n. 感觉，知觉

words.meaning_zh: 可弯曲的；灵活的，易变通的
words.example_en: We can visit your company on Monday or Tuesday. Our plans are fairly flexible.
words.example_zh: 我们可以在星期一或星期二去拜访贵公司。我们的计划是相当灵活的。
words.notes: [记] flexibility n. 灵活度  inflexible adj. 执着的，不屈的

words.example_en: Acoustic beauty is also very important to the modern gardens.
words.example_zh: 听觉美对现代庭园的设计也非常重要。

words.example_en: Microscopes and telescopes are optical instruments.
words.example_zh: 显微镜和望远镜是光学仪器。

words.meaning_zh: 夜间发生的；夜间活动的
words.example_en: Hamsters are nocturnal creatures.
words.example_zh: 仓鼠是夜间活动的动物。
words.word_formation: 字根 noct 指“夜（night）”。noctambulist 意为“梦游者”：noct（夜）+ ambul（走）+ ist（人）→ 夜里游荡的人。中文里把特别能熬夜的人称为“夜猫子”，对应的英语是 night owl（猫头鹰）。而早晨起来精神饱满的人则被形容为 fresh daisy，来自短语 (as) fresh as a daisy (in the morning)，即“像（早上的）雏菊一样精神”。

words.meaning_zh: 睡着的；休眠的；（动物等）冬眠的
words.example_en: Many living things are dormant in winter.
words.example_zh: 很多生物在冬季休眠。
words.word_formation: 字根 dorm 表示“睡眠（to sleep）”，如：dormitory（睡觉的地方 → 宿舍）。dormitory 一词常被简写为 dorm。如果你把 dormitory 的字母打乱顺序再重新组合，可拼写出 dirty room! 这种词语互为 anagram（变位词，即变换某个词或短语的字母顺序构成的新词或短语）。

words.example_en: Some animals can overwinter without the hibernation.
words.example_zh: 有些动物不需要冬眠也能过冬。
words.notes: [记] hibernate v. 冬眠，蛰伏

words.meaning_zh: v. 追踪；n. 足迹，踪迹；轨道
words.example_en: The hunter followed the animal's tracks.
words.example_zh: 猎人追踪动物的足迹。

words.meaning_zh: v. 追踪；查出；追溯；n. 痕迹；少许
words.example_en: They traced the criminal to a house in the city.
words.example_zh: 他们追踪罪犯追到了城里的一座房子里。
words.collocations: [搭] a trace of 一丝，少许  trace back to 追溯到

words.example_en: Sunny weather alternated with rain.
words.example_zh: 天气晴雨交替。
words.word_formation: 字根 alter 意为“其他的（other）”。英语中有一个拉丁借词 alter ego，在拉丁语中的字面意思就是“第二个我（second I）”，即“个性的另一面”，引用义为“知己，至交”。此外，看看电脑键盘上紧挨着空格键的替换键“Alt”，那就是 alternate 的简写。
words.notes: [记] alternative adj. 可供选择的 n. 可供选择的事物

words.meaning_zh: n. 被捕食的动物，猎物；v. 捕食
words.example_en: Snakes track their prey by its scent.
words.example_zh: 蛇通过猎物的气味来追踪猎物。

words.example_en: These predators of the African grasslands live on mice and rabbits.
words.example_zh: 非洲草原上的这些捕食性动物以捕食老鼠和兔子为生。
words.notes: [记] predation n. 捕食

words.example_en: One of the bombing victims was dead on arrival in hospital.
words.example_zh: 炸弹爆炸案的受害者之一刚被送到医院就死了。
words.collocations: [搭] fall a victim to 成为……的受害者；成为……的牺牲品

words.meaning_zh: n. 俘虏；adj. 被关押的；受控制的
words.example_en: Armed gunmen broke into the church and took the priest captive.
words.example_zh: 持枪歹徒闯入了教堂，扣押了神父。
words.notes: [记] captivate v. 迷住，迷惑

words.example_en: We took a defensive attitude in the negotiation.
words.example_zh: 我们在谈判时采取了守势。
words.notes: [记] defend v. 防卫  self-defensive adj. 自卫的

words.example_en: I underwent so much suffering in early years that I am afraid of nothing today.
words.example_zh: 早年我经历了如此多的苦难，如今已无所畏惧。

words.example_en: They suffered huge losses in the financial crisis.
words.example_zh: 他们在经济危机时遭受了巨大的损失。
words.collocations: [搭] suffer for 因……而吃苦头  suffer a loss 遭受损失

words.meaning_zh: 易受伤的，脆弱的；易受影响的
words.example_en: The young girl looked very vulnerable.
words.example_zh: 那个年轻姑娘看上去十分柔弱。
words.collocations: [搭] be vulnerable to 易受……影响的

words.example_en: The standard of living at that time was on the edge of subsistence.
words.example_zh: 当时的生活水平处于勉强维生的边缘。

words.example_en: Most scientists believe that water doesn’t exist on the surface of the moon.
words.example_zh: 多数科学家认为，月球表面不存在水。
words.notes: [记] existence n. 存在；生活方式

words.example_en: We’ve made great efforts to exterminate mosquitoes and flies.
words.example_zh: 我们付出了很大努力来消灭蚊蝇。
words.word_formation: 字根 term/termin 表示“界限（boundary）”，如：ex（出）+ termin（界限）+ ate（动词后缀）→ 逐出界限 → exterminate（根除）；de（加强）+ termine（界限）→ 确定界限 → determine（决定）；termin（界限）+ ate（动词后缀）→ 使限定 → terminate（[使]结束）。

words.meaning_zh: v. 驯养；制服；adj. 驯服的；乏味的
words.example_en: The tame lions can communicate and dance together with the actors.
words.example_zh: 这些驯服的狮子可以与演员交流并同台共舞。
words.collocations: [搭] tame nature 征服大自然

words.example_en: He turned his eyes towards the food which the keeper had brought.
words.example_zh: 他把视线转向看守人带来的食物。

words.example_en: The shepherd set out to look for the sheep that had wandered away.
words.example_zh: 牧羊人出发去找走失的羊。
words.word_formation: shep（来自 sheep [羊]）+ herd（牧人）→ 牧羊人。
words.notes: [记] sheepdog n. 牧羊犬
